title: TransactionDeclined
description: One declined authorization call publishes one TransactionDeclined event. Six payload fields name the attempt and the reason it failed, shaped after the 80-byte validation trailer at app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L180-L182 and the 350-byte daily transaction record at app/cpy/CVTRA06Y.cpy. Five envelope fields precede them, and the envelope is additive in full, because no source record carries one. The serializer checks an event before it reaches a topic, and the deserializer checks it again; a failed check on arrival routes the message to the dead-letter topic. Publish and consume paths appear in card-platform/docs/event-flow.md, and rationale for every choice here lives in card-platform/docs/decision-log.md.
$comment: app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L370-L378 runs the card cross-reference check first and the account check only while the reason code is still zero, so one event carries one code.

eventId.description: The idempotency key. Each consumer records this identifier before it applies side effects. Additive. No source field exists.

eventType.description: The routing discriminator. A consumer reads this field to learn which payload arrived. Additive. No source field exists.

schemaVersion.description: The contract version. The number matches the -v1 suffix in this file name, and a later version only adds fields. Additive. No source field exists.

occurredAt.description: The publish timestamp, in Coordinated Universal Time. The authorization service stamps it when it writes the event, and authorizedAt carries the time the authorization happened. Additive. No source field exists.

aggregateId.description: The account identifier, and always the Kafka message key. Width from XREF-ACCT-ID PIC 9(11) at app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy:L7. The payload field accountId carries the same value.

transactionId.description: The transaction identifier, sixteen characters. From TRAN-ID PIC X(16) at app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy:L5 and DALYTRAN-ID at app/cpy/CVTRA06Y.cpy:L5.

accountId.description: The account identifier, eleven digits. From XREF-ACCT-ID PIC 9(11) at app/cpy/CVACT03Y.cpy:L7. A consumer maps this field onto its own account column, and the envelope field aggregateId carries the same value.

declineReasonCode.description: The reject reason code, four digits zero-padded to the width the source writes. From WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON PIC 9(04) at app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L181. These four values are the whole set: 0100 at app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L385, 0101 at L397, 0102 at L410, and 0103 at L417. Any other code fails validation, and the message routes to the dead-letter topic.

declineReasonDescription.description: The reject reason text that pairs with the code, reproduced character for character from the source. From WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC PIC X(76) at app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L182. The four texts sit at app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L386, L398, L411 and L418.

amount.description: The attempted amount as a decimal string with two fractional digits. From DALYTRAN-AMT PIC S9(09)V99 at app/cpy/CVTRA06Y.cpy:L10, so nine digits sit before the point. A leading minus is valid. 50 of the 300 records in app/data/ASCII/dailytran.txt hold a negative amount.
amount.$comment: app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L548-L551 adds a non-negative amount to the cycle credit accumulator and a negative amount to the cycle debit accumulator.

maskedCardNumber.description: The card number with twelve asterisks in place of the leading digits and the last four digits left visible. Position and width from DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM PIC X(16) at app/cpy/CVTRA06Y.cpy:L15. The masking is additive: no source program masks a Primary Account Number (PAN), and app/bms/COCRDSL.bms:L96-L99 defines the card detail field at the full sixteen characters. The authorization decision runs on the full PAN, and masking happens where the event is serialized. The cross-reference read at app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L382-L383 keys on all sixteen characters.
